name: Victor Harbor
reason: Town with its own Wikivoyage article and chapter on the Fleurieu board: Granite Island causeway, foreshore, heritage railway, whale-watching (rule 1, 2).
objection: Seaside holiday town; draws are mostly Granite Island and beaches already separate candidates.

name: Carrickalinga
reason: Beach village the regional board singles out (white-sand beach, rock pools, International Dark Sky Community): second-tier beach stop.
objection: One counted source only, and a quiet village with little beyond the beach.

name: Second Valley
reason: Board and southaustralia.com both name it: protected bay, jetty, boat sheds, snorkelling with leafy sea dragons (two counted sources, rule 1).
objection: Small village; mostly a swim and jetty stop.

name: Myponga
reason: Town whose named draws are businesses (brewery, cafes, gin distillery) and a weekly market; the reservoir walks are covered by Myponga Reservoir Reserve (rules 2, 4).
objection: The board gives it its own destination page and it is a stop on the way south.

name: Mount Compass
reason: Farming town; the board lists strawberries, a golf course and a produce trail, nothing distinct to see or do for half an hour (rule 3).
objection: Board gives it its own page and a Produce and Tourist Trail.

name: Port Noarlunga
reason: Jetty, snorkel-able reef and Aquatic Trail named by the Fleurieu board as a nature attraction; boundary place with Adelaide, included under 'if unsure, include' (proposer to resolve region).
objection: Seaside suburb of Adelaide per sa-regions.md, so it could belong to sa-adelaide; only one counted source.

name: Aldinga
reason: Aldinga Beach is described by the board as one of the most iconic drive-on beaches on the peninsula; town gets its own board page (rule 1, second-tier beach).
objection: The town itself is dining and wine bars; the beach is the draw and one source only.

name: Maslin Beach
reason: Board page: ochre cliffs, Blanche Point reserve, diving, Australia's first legal nude beach; a named second-tier beach with notable character.
objection: One counted source.

name: Langhorne Creek
reason: A wine region named by Wikivoyage (one of four on the peninsula), the board and southaustralia.com, not a single cellar door; keep the region/town, individual wineries rejected.
objection: Wine-only draw; proposer may fold it into a region.

name: Milang
reason: Board names a heritage museum in two restored railway carriages and a historic shack settlement on Lake Alexandrina.
objection: For: quirky museum and foreshore. Against: one counted source, museum is small, town otherwise a rest stop.

name: Hindmarsh Island
reason: Wikivoyage (Goolwa) says the Murray Mouth is seen from Hindmarsh Island; board page covers birdwatching, fishing and Lonely Island; island reached by bridge from Goolwa.
objection: Island is mostly residential; the viewing is a short stop.

name: Currency Creek
reason: Board names Lions Park, Black Swamp heritage wetland and a tall rail viaduct, plus wineries; Wikivoyage lists the wine area.
objection: For: several small stops. Against: one counted source, mostly wine, short visit.

name: Clayton Bay
reason: Tiny riverside town whose named draw is the Oscar W lunch cruise (an operator, not a place) and boating (rule: operators are not spots).
objection: Pelicans and foreshore picnics could suit a short stop.

name: Delamere
reason: Locality on the Cape Jervis road; the board's text is accommodation and passing scenery, Art Wall is minor roadside (rule 3).
objection: Gateway stop to Kangaroo Island.

name: Inman Valley
reason: Rural locality whose board text is farm stays and a distillery (businesses); its one sight, Glacier Rock, is judged separately (duplicate of Glacier Rock).
objection: Wikivoyage mentions it, but only for Glacier Rock.

name: Waitpinga
reason: Locality and beach already covered by Newland Head Conservation Park (Waitpinga Beach, Waitpinga Cliffs); the other draw is a quad-bike operator. Duplicate of Newland Head Conservation Park.
objection: Waitpinga Beach is a well-known surf beach.

name: Kangarilla
reason: Small hills town; no source names anything to see (rule 1).
objection: None found.

name: McLaren Flat
reason: Small town in the wine region; no visitor source names a sight, cellar doors only.
objection: None found.

name: Christies Beach
reason: outside the region: belongs to sa-adelaide (Adelaide southern coast suburb, no named sight).
objection: Listed by the Fleurieu board.

name: Moana
reason: Suburb; its beach and dunes are covered by Moana Sands Conservation Park (duplicate), and no source names more.
objection: Moana Beach is a popular swimming beach.

name: Wirrina Cove
reason: Resort and marina locality; the draws are a resort golf course and charters (businesses), the HMAS Hobart dive is an operator trip.
objection: Marina and Tjilbruke Trail stretch.

name: Silver Sands
reason: Board (two listings) and southaustralia.com name Silver Sands as a drive-on beach for swimming and surfing near Aldinga: second-tier beach.
objection: Possibly near-duplicate of Aldinga Beach; a village with a seasonal pop-up beach club.

name: Clarendon
reason: Hills town; the named draw is a highland-cow farm experience (operator), and the Clarendon area lies in the Adelaide Hills side. outside the region: likely belongs to sa-adelaide.
objection: The Farm experiences are bookable.

name: Kuitpo
reason: outside the region: belongs to sa-adelaide (Kuitpo Forest is named under sa-adelaide's Adelaide Hills).
objection: Forest has walks and camping.

name: Newland Head Conservation Park
reason: Parks SA and board: Waitpinga and Parsons beaches, Waitpinga Cliffs, Wild South Coast Way section, views to Kangaroo Island.
objection: Remote; overlaps Waitpinga and Heysen Trail candidates.

name: Hindmarsh Valley National Park
reason: Duplicate of Hindmarsh Falls (the park is listed only for the falls).
objection: Is a national park of its own.

name: Hindmarsh Falls
reason: southaustralia.com, Visit Victor Harbor and the board name it; a 20 m waterfall best in winter and spring with a short walk to a viewing platform.
objection: Short visit and seasonal flow; access to the base is closed.

name: Ingalalla Falls
reason: Board lists it as a waterfall near Victor Harbor; only other source found is a waterfall-enthusiast site.
objection: For: one of few named waterfalls in dry SA. Against: one counted source, seasonal, short track, access details unclear.

name: Glenthorne National Park-Ityamaiitpinna Yarta
reason: outside the region: belongs to sa-adelaide (suburban O'Halloran Hill; Wikivoyage lists it under McLaren Vale as a boundary park).
objection: New national park with bike trails.

name: Wangkuntila-Aldinga Conservation Park
reason: Parks SA and board: Aldinga Scrub with sand blows and the Aldinga Washpool lagoon, walking trails.
objection: Fairly low-key bushland park, with one agency page.

name: Kyeema Conservation Park
reason: outside the region: belongs to sa-adelaide (Mount Lofty Ranges woodland near Kuitpo); also only bushwalk/birdwatching.
objection: Parks SA names 80 bird species.

name: Moana Sands Conservation Park
reason: Parks SA and board: coastal dunes with lookouts, hooded plover habitat, trails.
objection: For: a named coastal park and dune walk. Against: small, birdwatching and local use; boundary with Adelaide suburbs.

name: Bullock Hill Conservation Park
reason: Small bushland park near Ashbourne; the agency text offers birdwatching and local walks, nothing a visitor travels for (rule 3).
objection: Parks SA and the board both list it.

name: Cox Scrub Conservation Park
reason: Parks SA: 563 ha park with three walking trails and birdlife, listed by the board.
objection: For: a larger bush park with signed walks. Against: one agency page and one board listing, quiet local park.

name: Scott Creek Conservation Park
reason: outside the region: belongs to sa-adelaide (Adelaide Hills boundary).
objection: Walking trails.

name: Nangawooka Flora Reserve
reason: Small flora reserve in the hills near Cherry Gardens, in sa-adelaide's hills side; spring wildflowers only and no counted source beyond a list.
objection: Spring wildflower stop.

name: Tolderol Game Reserve
reason: Board lists it with a lookout and picnic area as a birdwatching site on Lake Alexandrina.
objection: For: wetland bird habitat. Against: game reserve, one listing, short visit.

name: Waitpinga Conservation Park
reason: No counted source names it; Waitpinga is covered by Newland Head Conservation Park.
objection: Protected area.

name: Talisker Conservation Park
reason: No visitor source found (parks.sa.gov.au page 404); heritage silver mine ruins are only on Wikipedia/heritage register (rule 1).
objection: Steep tracks and ruins next to Deep Creek.

name: Eric Bonython Conservation Park
reason: No counted source and no evidence of visitor features (rule 1).
objection: Conservation park.

name: Granite Island Causeway
reason: Duplicate of Granite Island (Granite Island Recreation Park).
objection: Causeway with horse tram.

name: Myponga Reservoir Reserve
reason: Board (two pages) and Myponga town page: opened to the public for walking, fishing, kayaking, with kangaroos and a view from the dam wall.
objection: Quiet reserve.

name: Mount Bold Reservoir Reserve
reason: outside the region: belongs to sa-adelaide (Adelaide Hills edge).
objection: Picnic and walks.

name: Happy Valley Reservoir Reserve
reason: outside the region: belongs to sa-adelaide (southern suburbs).
objection: Barbecue and picnic area.

name: Sturt Gorge Recreation Park
reason: outside the region: belongs to sa-adelaide (suburban edge).
objection: Walks.

name: Onkaparinga River Recreation Park
reason: Parks SA and board: wetland boardwalks, kayaking and trails at the river's estuary side near Old Noarlunga.
objection: For: boardwalks and kayaking. Against: overlaps the Onkaparinga River National Park candidate and Port Noarlunga; local use.

name: Nakurami Kondoli Whale Lookout
reason: southaustralia.com and board (two pages) name this free whale-watching platform at Kings Beach with views to West Island and The Bluff; on the Heysen Trail.
objection: For: named platform for the whale season. Against: a single lookout, short stop, part of the Victor Harbor coast.

name: Kleinigs Hill Lookout
reason: southaustralia.com attraction page and board name this council-run lookout above Victor Harbor.
objection: For: a guide singles it out. Against: short lookout, one source type.

name: Carrickalinga Lookout
reason: Lookout feature within Carrickalinga; no source gives it a distinct visit (rule 3).
objection: Board lists it as its own attraction.

name: Glacier Rock
reason: Wikivoyage (Victor Harbor) and the board: Selwyn's Rock, a glacial outcrop reached by a very short walk with steps.
objection: A ten-minute stop; keep as a quirky natural-history stop only.

name: John Crompton Reserve
reason: Local reserve listed only by the board with no visitor feature (rule 3).
objection: Lawn gardens, carpark.

name: Warland Reserve
reason: Victor Harbor foreshore reserve beside the town; an ordinary seaside park (rule 3).
objection: Listed with coach parking.

name: Second Valley Forest
reason: Forest reserve; the board lists it with no features, and Second Valley is covered separately (rule 3).
objection: Walks.

name: Strathalbyn Soldiers Memorial Garden
reason: Minor memorial garden (rule 3).
objection: Barbecue and coach parking.

name: Port Noarlunga Reef Sanctuary Zone
reason: Duplicate of Port Noarlunga (its jetty, reef and Aquatic Trail).
objection: Is a marine park zone in its own right.
